blocks.text: Michael Sager has officially joined the hosting lineup of “Pinoy Big Brother Collab 3.0,” marking a new chapter in his “PBB” journey after previously competing as a housemate. The announcement was made on Monday, Oct. 5, as the program shared a teaser of the hosts on social media. Sager joined returning “PBB” hosts Bianca Gonzalez, Robi Domingo, Gabbi Garcia, Melai Cantiveros, Enchong Dee and Alexa Ilacad.
